The HWPX inventory report generation succeeded with a perfect verifier reward, confirming the core document parsing and reporting logic is functional.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and passed the pytest suite in test_output.py without errors. While successful, the judge_reward of 0.83 suggests potential for optimization in output formatting or edge-case handling. Reusable components include the HWPX structure traversal, but future iterations should re-check path assumptions and XML namespace handling.
